question: review-0528 item 4 / KD-b: measure the KV-die frames that were ASSUMED before quoting a package size
method: yosys synth -flatten + abc to ASAP7 RVT TT liberty, cells only (tools/qwen_kv_die/synth/synth_area.sh, run_all.sh); utilisation = cells / frame; fp_lint limit 0.60

qkd_reng (re-cut D).note: composed from synthesis (row_engine_e 310 k measured + 512 x 404.77 FP32 add LAT 7 + registers); direct synthesis synth3/reng_d running

qkd_land (logic part).note: plus the qfd_kvc landing crossbar (r21c frame 96.768 um wide, not re-synthesised); the column width is set by the 32 CDC + 8 engine faces, not by area

qkd_astk (re-cut D).note: synthesis running (synth3/astk_d, -noshare); its score / e memories (4,096 x 128 + 4,096 x 64 b) are SRAM-macro class (~24-32 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256, ~0.12-0.16 mm2), not flops

summary: the centre blocks (seq, d2d, embgw, ahub) and the landing logic are measured at 1-30 % of their assumed frames: they do not set the die size (the KV die is set by the HBM PHY bands, the row-engine columns and the aggregator column). The re-cut D engine frame is sized from synthesis at 0.50 (KV die 192.1 mm2). The aggregator (qkd_astk) frame stays ASSUMED until synth3/astk_d reports.
